// Deliberate violations of the strict XState profile's binding rule.
// tests/xstate-profile-guard.test.ts checks this as a component, not a hook.
import { useActorRef, useSelector } from "@xstate/react";
import { badMachine } from "./bad-machine";

export const Panel = () => {
  // binding: useActorRef only in a use-*.ts hook.
  const actor = useActorRef(badMachine);
  // binding: useSelector(actor, selector) with no compare.
  const n = useSelector(actor, (s) => s.context.n, (a, b) => a === b);
  return n;
};

// binding: provide a machine only where useActorRef runs it.
export const provided = () => badMachine.provide({ actions: {} });
